instruction.german: Read the conversation in Figure it out and complete the rules in the grammar box.

parts:
Figure it out

Mika: Hi Georgina, I love your shirt! Where did you get it?

Georgina: Thanks! I bought it at the vintage shop.

Mika: Did you buy it today?

Georgina: No, I didn’t. I bought it two months ago. And I wore it for the first time last week.


Grammar | Past simple questions, short answers and time expressions

• To form a question in the past, we use 1 + I / you / he / she, etc. + infinitive form of the verb.

We put question words before did.

• For yes / no questions, the short answer is

Yes, I / you / he / she, etc. 2 or

No, I / you / he / she, etc. 3 .

• We use time expressions with the past simple, eg yesterday, a month ago, a week ago, two days ago. These are always at the beginning or end of a sentence:

4 + Monday / week / September …

… an hour / three days / one month + 5
